app.title: Access control
app.intro: Rules are the vocabulary, owners hold them, inheritance passes them on.
app.noScreens: Every screen is switched off in config/accessUi.php.
app.problems: Some configured entities could not be used:
rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: The tree of guard names the application checks against. A name changed here stops matching the code that asks for it.
rules.guardNameHint: What the code checks. Dots group it into a tree.
rules.optionSpecHint: Leave empty for a plain rule. Filled, it is a validation-rule string, and each option value is granted separately.
rules.readOnlyNotice: Rules are read-only in this installation. They change through migrations.
rules.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate this rule? Every check against it starts answering no. The permissions stay and it can be restored.
rules.confirmDelete: Delete this rule for good? Its permissions go with it and its children move up a level. This cannot be undone.
owners.title: Owners
owners.intro: The records that hold permissions. Open one to set what it may do, or where it takes its rights from.
owners.name: Name
owners.nameHint: What administrators see. Safe to change later.
owners.identifierHint: Stable machine name, referred to by migrations and seeders, so it should not change afterwards.
owners.notManagedHint: This type is not listed in config/accessUi.php. It is shown because it holds a permission of its own.
owners.confirmDelete: Delete this owner record? Its permissions and assignments go with it, and everyone who inherited from it loses what it held. The user or group it stands for is not touched. This cannot be undone.
permissions.intro: Allow or forbid each rule. A prohibition wins over an allowance, including an inherited one.
permissions.inherited: Comes from inheritance, not from this owner
permissions.pressAgain: Pressing a state that is already set clears it, which is how a grant is taken away. Cleared, the rule falls back to whatever inheritance says.
inherit.title: Inheritance
inherit.intro: Who inherits from whom. An inheritor keeps taking whatever the source holds, as the source changes.
inherit.pickSource: Pick a source on the left.
inherit.indirectHint: Reached through another link. Remove the direct one to drop it.
inherit.confirmRemove: Remove this link? Everything it was handing over is lost.
widget.title: Assigned access
